purpose: Enable actual full-target-basis physical inputs with a bounded CUDA factor producer after the complete public domain failure; no speed benchmark or chemical-accuracy pass claim
largest_case_selection: First lexicographically sorted required structure among the maximum spatial-basis-function count in the frozen full model-domain inventory; no reference-energy values used
large_probe: Generate the final whitened factor, which exercises global auxiliary mixing; do not claim all factors, molecular energy or a state prediction from that probe
independent_reference: For the small case only, compare all streamed factors with a separately assembled dense three-center tensor and GPU triangular solve; measure fitting energy error against independent exact four-center GPU integrals without using it to tune settings
runtime: One CUDA numerical job and one host core; no CPU integrals, scientific fallback, baseline method or frontier replication; bounded factor workspace and at most 0.5 GB new disk
scope: Physical integral-input implementation and fitting diagnostics, not a full public model score, learned transfer, XC callable or private-test pass
